DLA Troop Support, Subsistence Directorate, Operational Rations, Group Rations intends to solicit a request for proposal on Solicitation SPE3S1-26-R-0002. The proposed acquisition shall be Unrestricted for Full and Open competition with HUB Zone Price Evaluation Preference for Jalapeno Cashews/ Toaster Pastry Snack Mux to be utilized within the Unitized Group Ration – H&S & UGR-M programs.

Delivery shall be FOB Destination to Depot Tracy, CA.

CLIN 0001 JALAPENO CASHEW HALVES (SPLITS) NSN: 8925-01-675-9077 Item Description: CASHEW HALVES (SPLITS); Specification: CID A-A-20164E, TYPE III, Size 2, Style C (UNITIZED GROUP RATIONS ONLY)

 CLIN 0002 TOASTER PASTRY NSN: 8920-01-675-9070 Item Description: TOASTER PASTRY CHOC CHIP, FROSTED Specification: CID A-A-20211C, TYPE 1, STYLE B, FLAVOR 12, FORTIFICATION B, SHAPE I, SERVINGS (A) PACKAGE C, GRAIN COMP (1), AND FROSTING OPTION C, (UNITIZED GROUP RATIONS ONLY)

Contract Type: 3-Year Tiered Indefinite Delivery/Indefinite Quantity Contract

Source Selection Method: Lowest Price Technically Acceptable

Pricing Agreement: Firm Fixed-Price.

Inspection at Origin. Acceptance at Destination

All responsible parties may submit a proposal. Product Demonstration Models are required. If you are interested, immediately contact the Contracting Officer listed on this notice.
